form.label: Operations overview
form.description: From infrastructure health to the events that need your attention.

search.query: `zabbix_events` earliest=-7d | stats count by instance | fields instance

div.p: From infrastructure health to the events that need your attention.

search.query: | tstats dc(Events.event_uid) AS events FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Operations.Events WHERE Events.instance=$instance|s$
| tstats dc(Events.event_uid) AS events FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Operations.Events WHERE Events.instance=$instance|s$ (Events.severity=high OR Events.severity=disaster)
`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:collector | stats latest(status) AS status by instance input_name stream | where status="error" | stats count

| tstats dc(Events.event_uid) AS events FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Operations.Events WHERE Events.instance=$instance|s$ BY _time span=1h Events.severity | rename Events.severity AS severity | timechart span=1h sum(events) by severity
`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:events | dedup event_uid | stats count by dest | sort -count | head 12
`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:events | dedup event_uid | table _time instance dest severity status name eventid | sort -_time
